1.p: No automations, no boosts, no scheduled volume. Post two or three pieces manually per account so the handles have a pulse before anything is automated.

2.p: Full runbook, organic only. Start the boost log at zero spend so the habit exists before the money does.

3.p: Two weeks of posts means you can finally compute a median. The 36-hour rule starts this week.

4.p: Switch on GUIDE and SUPPORT, Instagram only, tested from a second account. Move the first tranche of freed budget into Ads Manager.

5.p: If week 4's automation logs are clean, add BREAKDOWN, PD and RETURNS, plus the Ocusafe and Neurolux keywords.

8.p: Compare blended ROAS and cost per purchase against the pre-restart 30 days, and decide whether the $400 / $700 split holds. Don't judge it earlier than this.

SEASON.1: FSA season starts now. Plant the first mention; don't push it yet.
SEASON.2: Fall frame refresh. Nothing seasonal to force this week.
SEASON.3: October is Eye Injury Prevention Month and Home Eye Safety Month — Ocusafe's biggest month of the year, on BOTH tracks. Build the assets this week, not next.
SEASON.4: Eye Injury Prevention Month. Two different posts: compliance for the safety manager on LinkedIn, and 'protect your own eyes, nobody's doing it for you' for the tradesperson on Instagram.
SEASON.5: Home Eye Safety Month — the DIY and workshop angle. The rare week where 39DG and Ocusafe content overlaps.
SEASON.6: Halloween decorative contact lenses. The FDA warns against unprescribed cosmetic lenses — the highest-authority thing a doctor-owned brand can publish, and it points at Online Contacts.
SEASON.7: Halloween week, plus the first real FSA reminder.
SEASON.8: November is Diabetic Eye Disease Awareness Month. Doctor Answers territory all month.
SEASON.9: Diabetic eye disease continues. FSA reminder two.
SEASON.10: Pre-Black Friday. The offer gets decided, the creative built and the queue loaded THIS week — not next.
SEASON.11: Thanksgiving Nov 26, Black Friday Nov 27. Peak week. If the queue wasn't loaded last week, this week is already lost.
SEASON.12: Cyber Monday Nov 30. Gift guide. FSA urgency starts ramping.
SEASON.13: FSA push in earnest, on 39DG AND Ocusafe — prescription safety eyewear is HSA/FSA eligible and almost nobody knows it. Publish your order-by dates so the deadline is concrete.
SEASON.14: Last order dates for holiday delivery. FSA urgency at peak.
SEASON.15: FSA final call — most plans expire Dec 31. Light posting, evergreen queue, inbox still staffed.
SEASON.16: FSA expires Dec 31 for most plans. Then pivot to new year, new prescription.
